_scoring.method: blind list saved to /tmp/auditA/blind.json before opening stored records; sample totals exclude the 2 calibration laws

_classes.name: lead_in borrowed from a different act section (rescued list item gets the wrong lead-in, so kind/actor can come from the wrong provision)
_classes.rule: for records with lead_in: strip braces/brackets from packet LAW TEXT, find norm(lead_in)[:80]; flag when no occurrence of the lead_in is followed by norm(quote)[:80] without an intervening line-start '§ N.' (48 of the 54 carry rescued_imperative_item=true)

_classes.name: 'the city' in a New York City law resolved to Cities group (jurisdiction local, no unit) instead of New York City
_classes.rule: agency=='Cities' and not agency_unit and re.search(r'city of new york|\bNYC\b|new york city', law_title, I)

_classes.name: benefit_entitlement gate drops grant caps and form-prescription sentences whose subject is not a beneficiary
_classes.rule: dropped rule=='benefit_entitlement' and quote ~ r'no (grant|loan|award|contract)s? shall be (made|awarded)|prescribed by the (commissioner|department|superintendent|director|board)'
_classes.note: only S1192-03 (raised grant ceiling, an amount extension) is counted as a miss; -02 (forms prescribed by the {{commissioner}}) is a holder rename, judged not a record; the 7 matches need reading

_classes.name: earlier chapter's sunset sentence amended inside the law (braced new date) with no extension record
_classes.rule: packet LAW TEXT has r'(deemed repealed|shall expire)[^.]{0,200}?\{\{' before the act's last 'This act shall take effect', with 'is amended to read' in the preceding 1500 chars, and no stored record of the law quotes /repeal|expire/ (law-level count)
_classes.note: upper bound: includes laws whose title names no government body (re-ask route sunset_extension_unnamed_holder); S6363 was re-asked 20261017, before the Oct 19 decision

_classes.name: text of a State pledge/covenant ('the state will not take any action') stored as a record
_classes.rule: quote ~ r'\bstate (will|shall) not (take any action|limit or alter|impair)'

_classes.name: one actor of a joint list left out (generic 'law enforcement authorities') or joint duty dropped as duplicate
_classes.rule: no mechanical rule; known class 'joint actors stored for one body' recurring
